$description: Hummel Hex (job 41): the tokens option-3-hummel gains for hexagonal, tactile controls. DTCG 2025.10. Everything outside `variant` applies to both variants; `variant.<name>` holds what differs. _tools/build-hex-variants.mjs merges option-3-hummel/tokens.json + this file into option-3a-hex-sharp/tokens.json and option-3b-hex-soft/tokens.json.

edge.$description: The visible bottom edge (depth) under tactile buttons and chips

honey-edge.$description: Side wall of a honey button between face and edge

surface-edge.$description: Side wall of a light chip or button (surface-raised face)

tip.$description: Width of each pointed end as a fraction of the control's height. 0.2887 = 1/(2·tan 60°): all six corners are 120°, the honeycomb angle.

reference-height.$description: Height at which corner-radius applies; the radius scales with the control's height

edge.$description: Visible bottom edge of a resting button: ink, side wall, ink. 6 px leaves a 2 px wall between the 2 px outlines

edge-l.$description: Edge of hero-size buttons and cards

press.$description: How far the face sinks on press: all the way into its edge

release.$description: Face returning after press or hover

corner-radius.$description: Hex Soft: every corner rounded with this radius at reference-height (48 px), scaled with the control's height

width.$description: Focus ring around a hex control, drawn on the unmasked control so the hex mask never clips it

gap.$description: Surface-coloured gap between the control and its focus ring

target.$description: Minimum interactive target, face plus edge
